limitations: Positive lead creation is checked for the three source-derived create-tier/no-CRM-match attendees, and the source-derived summary counts are checked. There is no prohibited-effect guard against duplicate CRM or Skip-attendee lead creation.
Names, company and title fields are not asserted because Zoom participant identity does not provide those CRM values.

public_basis: Prompt restricts processing to mtg_webinar_q1; other meeting IDs are excluded by exact meeting_id binding.
The bound tier rows define 0–19 Skip, 20–30 Low, 31–45 Medium, and 46+ High.
Bound initial Salesforce leads and contacts are keyed by email.
source_derived_summary_counts.note: Counts are derived from public attendees, tier rows and initial CRM email matches. Synthetic control email values test correct and wrong count handling; they are not the source of the expected values.
